purpose: Immutable printable publication report for one completed Brisbane calendar month.

identity.ReportingMonth: YYYY-MM for the previous complete Brisbane calendar month
identity.QueryVersion: version of the canonical extraction and layout contract
identity.AcceptedSourceBatchID: committed retained source batch used by the refreshed model
identity.ModelRefreshCorrelation: verified refresh identity or documented manual correlation receipt

acceptance: Status is committed only after CSV and HTML readback, independent counts and canonical key sets reconcile.
The artifact is immutable after commitment; a correction creates a new RunID and supersedes the prior manifest without overwriting it.
Publication dates with inadequate precision remain outside the monthly bibliography and are recorded in SourceCoverage.
A PDF export may accompany the artifact only where a supported licensed route exists; it is not evidence of complete bibliography output.
